fig2.definition: bars are the mean over conditions of the paired per-replicate difference; whiskers are the 95% percentile interval of that aggregated effect; diamonds are raw test-set point deltas

fig5.rule: mechanism panels use the extreme mean G = J - L over abnormal images; performance panels use the extreme per-image pixel AP difference (A1_L - A1_J). The labels state the selection metric, not success/failure, except in the performance panels where the metric is a localisation score.
fig5.note: per-image pixel AP is an illustration selector, not a pooled statistic; the pooled metric remains the category-level pooled AP
